text: Binary per-row: reads OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), with title and argument only as context for the OP's stated emotional experience. Returns 1 if at least one single comment explicitly acknowledges or validates the OP's emotional experience (e.g., feelings understandable, valid, legitimate) and that validation appears earlier in the same comment than that comment's logical rebuttal/counter-argument to the OP's view; both must be in the same comment, and separate comments don't combine. Returns 0 if comments exist but none qualify (validation only after rebuttal, no rebuttal, or only non-emotional agreement such as agreeing with facts). Empty comment list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null. Ignores quotations of others' positions the commenter doesn't adopt, and moderator/bot notices. Excludes OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even in the argument); generic delta/platform-rule discussion is not excluded. Uses current text only, with no inference of initial snapshots or comment order across the list.
